summary: Full backend + frontend smoke pass for cooling-tower dashboard. All 8 backend endpoint groups return expected shapes/fields; PATCH mutations for alerts and settings persist correctly. Frontend renders Overview with both tower cards, TowerDetail with all 6 sensor tiles + 4 power tiles + trend chart + fouling + savings, all 4 trend-range buttons work, Alerts page shows 200 rows with 200 acknowledge buttons, and Tariff modal updates topbar (verified visually as ₹11.25/kWh after save).
passed: GET /api/towers/CT-01 returns metadata (id, name, location, design_flow_m3h, baseline_*)
GET /api/towers/CT-01/snapshot returns values with flow_m3h/supply_temp_c/return_temp_c/conductivity_us/turbidity_ntu/filter_dp_kpa/fan_kw/pump_kw/chiller_kw and 15 devices
GET /api/towers/CT-01/analytics/latest returns all required KPIs incl. cumulative_savings_lost, fouling_category, hours_to_cleaning, savings_lost_rupees_delta
GET /api/alerts (200) and ?acknowledged=false (200); PATCH /api/alerts/{id} sets acknowledged:true (verified via re-GET)
GET /api/settings + PATCH tariff 12.5 persisted; restored to 9.0
Overview page renders tower-card-CT-01 & tower-card-CT-02 with KPIs and top strip
tower-card-open-CT-01 navigates to /tower/CT-01 and tower-detail-CT-01 renders
All 6 sensor tiles (flow/supply/return/conductivity/turbidity/filter_dp) show numeric values
All 4 power tiles (fan/pump/chiller/total) show numeric values
trend-chart-CT-01 renders; trend-range 6/24/72/168 buttons all clickable
nav-alerts navigates to /alerts; alerts-table shows 200 rows with 200 alert-ack-* buttons
Tariff modal (topbar-tariff-btn -> tariff-input -> tariff-save) updates topbar to '₹11.25/kWh' (visually confirmed in screenshot)
notes: In GET /api/towers response, active_alerts is an integer count (not an array). Frontend appears to consume it fine; original spec text said 'active_alerts' — treat as design choice unless main agent intended a list.
Tower object uses top-level key 'id' (not 'tower_id'), which is by design per handoff note.
